c.v: The ESP32-S3 chip features 45 physical GPIO pins.
Each pin can be used as a general-purpose I/O, or be connected to an internal peripheral signal.
Through GPIO matrix, IO MUX, and RTC IO MUX, peripheral input signals can be from any GPIO pin, and peripheral output signals can be routed to any GPIO pin.
Together these modules provide highly configurable I/O.
Note that the 45 GPIO pins are numbered from 0 ~ 21 and 26 ~ 48.
All these pins can be configured either as input or output.
